name: TVZone Media Co., Ltd.
summary: TVZone Media Co., Ltd. produces, distributes, and markets video content for television, Internet, and mobile Internet, TV series, broadcasting operation, and film television drama in China. The company primarily engages in the production of online movies, documentaries, TV series, short videos, and other video content. It also operates Taojutao and Zhongxugou, an online trading platform for TV drama copyrights. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Changsha, China. TVZone Media Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Changsha Broadcast & Television Group.
